answer_1.quote: We introduce the concept of spotlight generation and formally define the problem... we propose a Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)-based fine-tuning algorithm to generate spotlights.
answer_1.outputs: spotlights (concise, self‑contained narratives that highlight the most engaging aspects of a document)

answer_2.quote: We assess the quality of the generated spotlights using the metrics defined in Table… (A) Traditional: we check the competence of different models with traditional evaluation metrics like Rouge1 (R1), Rouge2 (R2), and BERT‑F1 (BeF1).

answer_3.quote: GPT‑4 is asked to rate the spotlight –whether the spotlight is good or bad… We also use Gemini‑Pro with the same prompts and criteria as used earlier for GPT‑4.
methods: pairwise comparison of spotlight vs. summary

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human annotation study focused on interest generation. For each dataset, 50 documents were selected and two independent annotators were asked to indicate whether the summary or the spotlight was more likely to generate interest… Inter‑annotator agreement was 0.87.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were presented with a summary and a spotlight and asked to judge which one generated more interest (and in other studies whether each text qualified as a mini‑story).
